name: paseo-cto
description: CTO operating model over external Paseo agents (any provider): the main loop plans, hands out machine-checkable tasks with exclusive file zones, reviews by execution with one-line verdicts, integrates and pushes, serializes deploys against live runs, and keeps the fleet busy from the roadmap on a fixed self-check cycle. Token-economical: the CTO spends judgment, the fleet spends tokens.
